scenario.name: Stateful UDP comparison caller
scenario.send: INVITE sip:bench@mako.local SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/UDP [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch];rport From: caller <sip:caller@mako.local>;tag=[call_number] To: bench <sip:bench@mako.local> Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 1 INVITE Contact: <sip:caller@[local_ip]:[local_port]> Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Length: 0

ACK [next_url] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/UDP [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch];rport From: caller <sip:caller@mako.local>;tag=[call_number] To: bench <sip:bench@mako.local>[peer_tag_param] Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 1 ACK Contact: <sip:caller@[local_ip]:[local_port]> [routes] Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Length: 0

BYE [next_url] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/UDP [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch];rport From: caller <sip:caller@mako.local>;tag=[call_number] To: bench <sip:bench@mako.local>[peer_tag_param] Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 2 BYE [routes] Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Length: 0
